utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the repair drive. I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I’m keeping my ears open and I’ll let you know if I catch anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So there really haven’t been any new updates yet? Let me know as soon as you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s right, nothing new yet — but I’m on it, and I’ll tell you the moment I hear something.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when and where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Vik — that’d be really helpful. I might need a reminder on the exact time and place later.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — just remind me and I’ll repeat the time and place for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Ira — I can help with the repair drive. What’s the first thing you need sorted?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — first we need to figure out which repairs are top priority and who can take each one.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can start a quick list of the urgent repairs and match them to folks who can handle each one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Rey. We’re still short on a few supplies, so an extra hand would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — what supplies are you still short on?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help around the school schedule, but I’ll need the repair drive details first. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — I’m thinking Saturday morning around 9, and I’ll send the repair drive details over right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 works for me. Send over the repair drive details when you can, and I’ll plan around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Oren. Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli — I think the porch light is out and the fence gate is sticking. If we can just get those sorted, I’ll be grateful.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds manageable. I’ll take the porch light first, then we’ll see what that gate needs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or share the details?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please share the details first—I need to check the timing and where it’s happening before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, with tools and lunch provided. If you want, I can also send you the full flyer with the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re pulling together the final list of fixes and matching each one with a volunteer or neighbor who can help. If you’ve got a repair you want included, I can add it right now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—please add my porch light and the loose step by the front walk.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact date, time, and what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s this Saturday at 10:00 a.m. in the community hall, and we’re fixing small appliances, bikes, and loose furniture joints.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got it: this Saturday at 10:00 a.m. at the community hall, for small appliances, bikes, and loose furniture joints.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I may need to keep my involvement quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — I’ll keep it quiet and fill you in on the details when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Send me the details when you can, and I’ll do what I can quietly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — if the repair drive needs any tools, I’ve got a few you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — that helps. What tools do you think we’ll actually need?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’d start with a hammer, screwdriver set, adjustable wrench, and a tape measure — those usually cover most fixes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is happening, just so I don’t miss it. Do you know the exact location yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t know the exact spot yet—still waiting on the details. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — just let me know as soon as you get the location.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got some tools I can bring by for the repair drive. Let me know what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’d be really helpful. I’ll make a quick list of what’s still missing and bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll be around when you’re ready. Just bring the list by and I’ll see what I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the time, location, and what we’re expected to bring before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, that makes sense — do we have the time and place yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, but once we have the time and place, I can decide whether I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — please pass along that we’re looking for folks who can help with small repairs, tools to lend, and anyone who needs something fixed. I’ll keep you posted if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word for helpers, tools, and repair requests. Keep me posted if there’s anything specific you want me to mention.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list for the repair drive and let you know what we’re short on. Just tell me what’s already been gathered.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll swing by late and bring what I’ve got. If you spot anything missing, let me know and I’ll try to grab it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll check the list and let you know if anything’s missing. We’ll make sure the repair drive is covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s getting a good bit of attention already — I heard folks are still dropping things off this afternoon. If you want, I can keep an eye out and tell you if they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess—that’d be great. If they need anything specific, let me know and I’ll help coordinate around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if they ask for anything special. I’ll catch you after school pickup if I hear something.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — could you help me track down a few neighbors who’ve got tools or can lend a hand? I’ll keep the list organized and let you know the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll ask around and see who can lend tools or help out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Leo — what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — can you bring a drill and a few screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll bring a drill and a few screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Nell—there’s a repair drive happening soon, and I think you should come by. I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Quinn—that’d be great. Just send me the details when you get them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll pass them along as soon as I get them. It should be a nice chance to help out and catch up with folks!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the repair drive is still at the community center lot. If you want, I can double-check the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal — please double-check the exact spot, and let me know where to find it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll go check the community center lot and report back with the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — are we starting the repair drive today, or do you need me to help set anything up first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — let’s check the details first. If everything’s ready, we can start today; otherwise, I could use your help setting things up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — what’s still missing? I can help set it up right now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. If you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Oren — if I hear anything on my rounds, I’ll pass it along right away.
